hypotheses.claim: Direct capability separation is necessary but insufficient for high-consequence visually conditioned effects if a learned familiarity fast path may suppress fresh action-specific perception; high-risk commit should require a risk-sensitive perceptual evidence floor in addition to valid execution authority.
hypotheses.prediction: Under a policy that allows KNOWN_HIGH_CONFIDENCE familiarity to bypass broad recognition independently of action risk, there exist states where a valid capability plus false/stale familiarity permits a high-risk effect without fresh confirmation.
hypotheses.falsifier: An executable H1/ClayCode policy can prove that every high-consequence effect already requires fresh action-specific observation or deterministic precondition evidence, making the proposed extra closure redundant.

hypotheses.claim: A risk-sensitive evidence floor can preserve low-risk familiarity routing utility while eliminating familiarity-only high-risk commits.
hypotheses.prediction: Low-risk GOLD/SILVER KNOWN_HIGH cases remain fast-path eligible, while high-risk cases require CONFIRMED action-specific evidence.
hypotheses.falsifier: Real visual/action workloads show unacceptable latency/utility loss or no safety gain versus the existing policy.

hypotheses.claim: The closure can initially be represented as typed runtime/effect metadata without a new ClayCode surface primitive.
hypotheses.prediction: Existing typed records/effect contracts can carry perceptual_basis_ref, risk_class and required_evidence_floor through parser/IR/runtime/effect gateway.
hypotheses.falsifier: A production compiler/Harness counterexample proves the existing generic typed/effect basis cannot express or enforce the boundary.

counterhypotheses.claim: Capability gating alone is sufficient because wrong perception is ordinary task error rather than an authority failure.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Compare action error and protected-state consequence rates with/without risk-sensitive perceptual evidence floor while capability policy is held constant.

counterhypotheses.claim: Existing UNKNOWN/CONFLICT/open-set escalation already makes a separate action-risk evidence floor redundant.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Inject false KNOWN_HIGH outputs that evade UNKNOWN/CONFLICT; test whether high-risk action commit still requires independent fresh evidence.

counterhypotheses.claim: Always forcing deep perception before every effect is simpler and safer.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Measure low-risk routing latency/compute utility versus risk-sensitive gating; reject risk-sensitive design if it adds complexity without preserving material fast-path benefit.
